LanguageData.NOW.EnableDedup: Deduplicate duplicate messages in short time
LanguageData.NOW.EnableDedupDesc: When enabled, identical notifications within 3 seconds are pushed only once.
LanguageData.NOW.MergeWindowDesc: Multiple fragments of the same event (a letter and its accompanying messages) are merged into a single notification within this window; independent messages are pushed separately. Set to 0 to disable merging.
